provenance: fully synthetic independent-Poisson predictions; no detector calibration or laboratory data
convention: entry[i][j] = D_KL(Poisson model_i || Poisson model_j); rows are reference hypotheses
limitations: Assumes independent Poisson measured channels and fixed response matrix.
No nuisance integration, priors, posterior model probabilities or experiment optimizer.
KL separation is design- and exposure-dependent.
